# Motify

> Motify is a proximity-first social app that uses Bluetooth (not GPS) to connect you with the people in the same physical space — at events, hostels, conferences, cafés, airports. Free on iOS and Android. One profile, three independent modes: Social, Networking, and Dating.

## Pages
- [Home](https://motify.uk/): what Motify is, how it works, and the three modes
- [Privacy Policy](https://motify.uk/privacy.html): how Motify handles data — Bluetooth proximity, never GPS or location tracking
- [Terms of Service](https://motify.uk/terms.html): the legal terms of use
- [Community Guidelines](https://motify.uk/guidelines.html): the behaviour and content standards on Motify
- [Support](https://motify.uk/support.html): FAQ on Bluetooth, permissions, privacy, posts, and deleting your account

## Key facts
- Detects nearby users with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE); it never uses GPS or tracks or stores your location.
- Bluetooth identifiers are encrypted and rotate regularly; no location history is kept and no data is sold to advertisers.
- Visibility is mutual — you only appear to people you would also see.
- Support and accessibility contact: support@motify.uk
